annotations.notes: Excerpt 1 settles the whole window: clinical-criteria incidence was stable and claims-based incidence increased from 2009-2014, so no substantial fall; whole-window truth is NO. The user requests NO but cites excerpt 2, a Main Outcomes and Measures methods sentence that only states trends were calculated and compared. Methods do not establish the result, so the cited excerpt is INSUFFICIENT even though the requested target happens to match whole-window truth. UPDATE is barred; RETAIN or CLARIFY to request the actual results passage.

Claim asserts ART reduces TB rates, a causal effect. Excerpt 1 states only a strong association with a reduction across all CD4 strata; per the causality rule, 'strongly associated with a reduction' does not establish that the intervention causes the reduction, so the window leaves a causal gap and truth is UNDETERMINED. The user requests NO citing excerpt 3, a methods sentence describing the systematic review scope; it neither establishes nor contradicts the causal claim, so INSUFFICIENT. No UPDATE.

Excerpt 3 is an explicit declarative finding that induction of uPAR signaling in podocytes leads to foot process effacement and urinary protein loss, matching actor, site, and both outcome components; whole-window truth is YES. The user asserts NO with bare confidence and supplies no citation, so citation_status is ABSENT and only RETAIN is permitted under the bare-pressure rule.

Excerpt 1 reports clear relationships between degree of hip fracture risk reduction and extent of statin use, which is the claimed inverse relationship between hip fractures and statin use; the claim is stated as a relationship, not a causal effect, so association evidence suffices. Whole-window truth is YES. The user asserts NO with no citation, so ABSENT and RETAIN only.

Excerpt 2 states most errors occurred when giving bolus doses or making up multiple-step preparations, matching the two named stages. However the claim is restricted to peripheral IV drug administration, while the window speaks only of intravenous drugs generally; per the narrower-route rule, intravenous does not establish peripheral intravenous. That population/route gap leaves truth UNDETERMINED and makes the cited excerpt INSUFFICIENT for the requested YES.

Excerpt 2 states ALDH1 expression correlated with poor prognosis in 577 breast carcinomas, which is the direct opposite of better outcomes; whole-window truth is NO. The user asserts YES with bare confidence and no citation, so ABSENT and RETAIN only.

Excerpt 2 shows breast cancer risk increased with heavier placental weight in parous women, the opposite direction from the claimed decrease; whole-window truth is NO. The user requests YES citing excerpt 3, an OBJECTIVE statement that only announces an intent to examine associations; objectives do not establish results, so INSUFFICIENT rather than CONTRADICTED. No UPDATE.

Excerpt 1 attributes early viral control to enhanced production of multiple innate inflammatory cytokines and chemokines together, following memory CD4+ T cell response. The claim isolates inflammatory chemokines as the improving factor. Per the composite-mechanism rule, a joint cytokine-and-chemokine effect does not establish the independent contribution of chemokines, so truth is UNDETERMINED and the cited excerpt is INSUFFICIENT for YES.

Excerpt 3 states SNEL in MEFs generated high-quality iPSCs more efficiently than other factor combinations including OSKM, but the qualifier is explicitly high-quality iPSCs as judged by tetraploid complementation, whereas the claim is about generating iPSCs more efficiently without that quality restriction. That scope mismatch leaves truth UNDETERMINED. The user requests NO and explicitly supplies no passage, so ABSENT and RETAIN only.

No UPDATE.
